title: Windows ALL TCP & UDP v3_2 Linux bridge
summary: Linux/nfqws2 bridge of the owner-provided Windows winws2 preset ALL TCP & UDP v3_2: broad owner-scoped TCP first-payload syndata and UDP QUIC fake handling, without WinDivert-only wf/raw-part options. This revision omits profile hostlists so SYN-level syndata is not blocked before hostname discovery and queues inbound TCP SYN/ACK/FIN/RST for Linux seq/ack handling.
intendedFor: проверка гипотезы, что на этом операторе работает не Discord-specific ветка, а широкий all-sites first-data профиль из Windows GUI
ручной owner-confirmed запуск на Linux/Flatpak Discord после неудачных community-discord-syndata-edge-flow вариантов
сравнение с текущим Discord/VLESS route; стратегия не чинит отдельно сломанный SOCKS/VLESS preflight
notes: Source preset uses --wf-tcp-out/--wf-udp-out and --wf-raw-part; those are WinDivert capture options and are represented here by capturePolicy/nft owner-scoped ports instead of runtimeArgs.

Source preset references lua/custom_diag.lua and lua/zapret-multishake.lua, but these files are not present in the vendored Linux core and are not needed by the used send/syndata/pktmod/fake functions, so the bridge omits them.

Source preset excludes lists/ipset-ru.txt, lists/ipset-dns.txt and lists/ipset-exclude.txt. These lists are not present in the uploaded Linux project, so this bridge intentionally avoids --ipset-exclude rather than adding broken file references.

The capture envelope is deliberately broad: owner UID TCP 80 and 443-65535, UDP 443-65535, first original packets only. This can affect unrelated owner traffic while enabled. The Linux bridge no longer applies standalone pktmod/tcp_flags_unset=ack to accepted packets because nfqws2 pktmod mutates the real packet and can blackhole TLS/HTTP traffic.
Blob files are loaded from core/zapret2/files/fake and copied to public runtime inputs by the session runner before nfqws2 drops privileges.
Linux safety fix 2026-06-29: keep tcp_flags_unset=ack only on the rawsend duplicate created by send; do not run standalone pktmod on accepted owner packets.

Linux route fix 2026-06-29: enable --bind-fix4/--bind-fix6 because this strategy relies on rawsend/syndata replacing the original SYN with a raw SYN+data packet; without bind-fix the raw packet can leave through the wrong interface or fail to mirror the kernel route on setups with policy routing, VPN, namespaces or Flatpak-adjacent routing.
Linux fidelity fix 2026-06-29: UDP capture/filter now includes port 80 as in the source --wf-udp-out=80,443-65535; the previous bridge only queued 443-65535.

Linux fidelity fix 2026-06-29 #2: this Windows all-sites preset must not inherit the profile hostlist. A regular --hostlist makes SYN packets with no known hostname fail profile matching, so the SYN-level syndata step can be skipped before TLS SNI exists.

Linux fidelity fix 2026-06-29 #2: enable inbound SYN/ACK and FIN/RST queueing for the source ports covered by --wf-tcp-out. Windows winws2 captures the reverse side of outbound TCP flows; nfqws2 needs that path for early-flow bookkeeping and syndata seq/ack handling.
